# has romantic orientation

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasRomanticOrientation`](gmeow-hasRomanticOrientation.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasRomanticOrientation>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/sexuality`](../../slices/sexuality.md)

Relates a person to a self-asserted romantic-orientation facet. Non-functional and contextual; a superseded one is kept with [`gmeow:displayable`](gmeow-displayable.md) false, never deleted. MUST NOT be inferred from [`gmeow:hasSexualOrientation`](gmeow-hasSexualOrientation.md), [`gmeow:hasGenderIdentity`](gmeow-hasGenderIdentity.md), [`gmeow:sexAssignedAtBirth`](gmeow-sexAssignedAtBirth.md), pronouns or honorifics.
